hero.title: Edstore
hero.description: Story-based mobile learning app optimized for fast, on-the-go content

meta.scope: Discovery → Core App Flows → Market Research → Brand Guidelines → Value-added Flows → Launch

parts.label: Mobile
parts.text: The first concept copied a heavy web platform. We moved to a story-based mobile format with full-screen media, short lesson pages, and quick access to active courses.

parts.label: Editor
parts.text: After 20+ interviews and a survey of 500+ early users, we removed the in-app lesson editor. The audience was experienced experts with content teams, not first-time solo creators.

parts.label: Publishing
parts.text: Lessons followed a social-friendly format, with guidelines so creators could publish both video and text without rebuilding every lesson for the app.

sections.title: From Web Platform to Mobile Learning

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: The original concept replicated a feature-heavy web platform and was not suited to fast, on-the-go learning.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We reviewed the previous experiment, analyzed the market, and explored how users consumed educational content on mobile devices.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We shifted to a story-based format with full-screen media, concise lesson pages, and quick access to active courses.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A focused mobile learning product designed around short, engaging content rather than desktop workflows.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: The team assumed that creators needed a complete lesson editor inside the app, making the product increasingly complex.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We tested multiple editor concepts, conducted 20+ interviews, and surveyed more than 500 early users.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: The research showed that the primary audience was experienced experts working with content teams, not first-time solo creators. We removed the editor and simplified lesson setup.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A leaner product aligned with real creator workflows, without investing further in a feature the core audience did not need.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Creators needed to reuse existing content without rebuilding every lesson specifically for the platform.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We analyzed different content formats and established creator workflows.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We added reusable content packs, consistent media formats, automated content tagging, and guidelines for both video and text-based lessons.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A flexible publishing system that made existing content easier to adapt, distribute, and recommend inside the app.
